Final for Publication App No. 2288771

SUBSTITUTE PROJECT NARRATIVE
TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT APPLICATION
FROM M2-3-Light Industry District to an DX-5 Downtown Mixed-Use District LG
Development Group LLC and 1201 W. Kinzie, LLC (THE “APPLICANTs”)
1201 - 1219 W. Kinzie St. and 366 -372 N. Racine Ave.

The Applicants seek approval for a Type 1 zoning amendment to construct a new 65,000 sf, 66-unit
residential building that will consist of one, two, three and four bedroom units and efficiency units with
14 indoor parking spaces and one loading area. The 5-story building will have a maximum height of
approximately 71 feet. The Project will seek an administrative adjustment to reduce the parking from 33
to 14 spaces, a variation to reduce the rear yard setback from 30’ to 0’ and a separate special use approval
to allow residential units on the ground floor. The building will have a floor area ratio of 5. Applicant to
seek all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code for the attached plans

ARO: The project does trigger the requirements of the requirements of Section 2-44-085 of the Municipal
Code of Chicago (the “ARO”) and the Applicants intend to locate the affordable units on-site.

TSL: The subject property is a Transit Served Location based on proximity to CTA Green Railway line
segment

Building Height: Approximately 71 feet. DX-5 Maximum Building Height: None.

Lot Area: 14,000 square feet (Recorded Measurement)
DX-5 Maximum Base F.A.R.: 5

Proposed F.A.R.: 5

Building Area: Approximately 65,000 square feet

Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit = 212 sf (14,000/66) with 16 EUs (24%) DX-5: 200 sf for
dwelling and 135 efficiency units and maximum of 30% EUs.

Special Use approval is requested to allow residential units on the ground floor.

On-Site Accessory Parking: Required 33 spaces Proposed: 14 spaces

Building Height: Approximately 71’- 0”
DX-5 Maximum Building Height: None

Setbacks:
Front: 0”
Side: 0’
Side: 0”
Rear: 0”
Loading Space: DX-5: 10 x 25 sf

Applicants: LG Development Group LLC and 1201 W. Kinzie, LLC
Address: 1201 - 1219 W. Kinzie St. and 366 -372 N. Racine Ave.
Introduction Date: September 25, 2025

Plan Commission Hearing: March 19, 2026
